resources.string: Usage access not granted — nothing new is being recorded
Battery optimization active — sync may be delayed
Notifications on — you\'ll hear when syncing stops, and about the evening review
Notifications off — the app can\'t tell you when syncing stops (signed out, usage access lost, a day without sending) or ask about the evening review
When sessions stop being recorded or sent
Shown while the app watches which app is in front for a nudge. Silent.
Notices which app is in front so nudges arrive on time. Records nothing.
Nothing new is being recorded. Tap to turn usage access back on.
Your session ended. Sign in again to keep syncing — usage is still recorded meanwhile.
Usage is recorded but not sent. Sign in to keep syncing.
%1$d sessions are waiting — offline, or the server can\'t be reached. Tap to see the status.
Sent %1$d new sessions (%2$d already on the server)
Waiting — offline or the server is busy. Sessions are kept and sent later.
Signed out — sign in again. Sessions are kept until then.
Usage access is off — nothing new can be recorded
The server ignored %1$d sessions (check the phone\'s clock)
The server refused %1$d sessions as malformed; they were discarded
The phone\'s clock is %1$d minutes ahead of the server — sessions from the future are ignored
Unexpected response from the server. Try again.
This account can\'t sign in to the tracker right now. Check the web app.
Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
Your account must set up two-factor authentication. Do it in the web app, then sign in here.
Your session ended. Sign in again — nothing recorded meanwhile is lost.
Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
That code didn\'t work. Try the current one.
Once an evening: which apps took your phone time today without being mapped to an activity
%1$s of phone time today isn\'t mapped
%1$s and %2$d more. Tap to map them.
Ask each evening about unmapped phone time
At your evening-shutdown time: the apps that took the most of today without an activity, one tap each. Needs notifications.
%1$s of phone time today isn\'t mapped to an activity. Map the biggest ones — a tap puts their time into History right away.
Ignored — it won\'t be asked about again
You have no activities yet. Add some in the web app.
Nothing to review — today\'s phone time is mapped, or too little is left to ask about.
All done. Tomorrow\'s time will be mapped by these rules.
Can\'t reach the server. Check the connection.
The server couldn\'t give today\'s list. Try again in a moment.
That app was mapped meanwhile — reloaded.
That activity no longer exists. Choose another.
Couldn\'t save — check the connection and try again.
